name: io.github.donofdebt/cashformynote-mcp
title: Cash For My Note Calculators
description: Mortgage note math: value at a yield, yield, partials, balloons, amortization, LTV, payment streams

tools.name: note_price
tools.description: A mortgage note's value is the present value of its remaining monthly payments (plus any balloon) at the yield a buyer requires, and this tool computes that price. It works the same for mortgage notes, land contracts (contracts for deed), owner-financed notes and other real estate notes. Optionally compares the price with the unpaid balance (discount and % of balance). Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

payment.description: Monthly payment in USD (principal and interest).

months.description: Number of monthly payments LEFT (not the original term).

yield.description: Target yield the buyer needs, annual % (monthly compounding).

balloon.description: Balloon (lump sum) due with the last payment, USD. Default 0.

balance.description: Unpaid principal balance in USD, greater than 0.

rate.description: Note interest rate, annual %. With balance, lets the tool compute the payment at full precision instead of taking payment.

tools.name: note_yield
tools.description: A note's yield is the annual return that makes its remaining payments (and any balloon) worth exactly the price paid, and this tool solves for it. It assumes every payment is made on time. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

price.description: Price paid for the note, USD.

payment.description: Monthly payment in USD (principal and interest).

months.description: Number of monthly payments LEFT (not the original term).

balloon.description: Balloon (lump sum) due with the last payment, USD. Default 0.

tools.name: yield_ladder
tools.description: A note's price falls as the yield a buyer requires rises, and this tool prices the same remaining payments at up to 12 yields side by side to show how much. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

payment.description: Monthly payment in USD (principal and interest).

months.description: Number of monthly payments LEFT (not the original term).

balloon.description: Balloon (lump sum) due with the last payment, USD. Default 0.

balance.description: Unpaid principal balance in USD, greater than 0.

rate.description: Note interest rate, annual %. With balance, lets the tool compute the payment at full precision instead of taking payment.

tools.name: partial_purchase
tools.description: In a partial note sale the holder sells only the next N payments and the rest revert to the holder, and this tool prices those payments at a target yield. It also shows what the holder keeps and the balance when payments revert. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

payment.description: Monthly payment in USD (principal and interest).

months.description: Number of monthly payments LEFT (not the original term).

payments_bought.description: How many upcoming payments the buyer purchases.

yield.description: Target yield the buyer needs, annual % (monthly compounding).

balloon.description: Balloon (lump sum) due with the last payment, USD. Default 0.

rate.description: Note interest rate, annual %. With balance, lets the tool compute the payment at full precision instead of taking payment.

tools.name: balloon_note
tools.description: A balloon payment is the lump sum due when a loan's remaining balance comes due before its monthly payments would pay it off, and this tool computes the monthly payment, the balloon amount and (with a yield) the note's price. Use it for a balloon mortgage or note whose payment is set on a long amortization but whose balance is due early. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

balance.description: Unpaid principal balance in USD, greater than 0.

amortization_months.description: Months the payment is calculated over, e.g. 360.

balloon_month.description: Month the remaining balance is due, counted from now.

yield.description: Target yield the buyer needs, annual % (monthly compounding).

payment.description: Actual monthly payment if it differs from the calculated one.

tools.name: loan_payment
tools.description: A fixed-rate loan's monthly payment is the level amount that pays off the balance with interest over the number of months, and this tool computes it for a mortgage, land contract or other installment note. Optionally leaves a balloon. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

balloon.description: Balloon (lump sum) due with the last payment, USD. Default 0.

tools.name: remaining_balance
tools.description: The remaining balance is the principal still owed after a number of on-time payments, and this tool computes it from the balance, rate and payment. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

payment.description: Monthly payment in USD (principal and interest).

tools.name: amortization_schedule
tools.description: An amortization schedule shows how each monthly payment splits into interest and principal and what balance is left, and this tool lists it month by month (up to 600 rows) with totals. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

balance.description: Unpaid principal balance in USD, greater than 0.

payment.description: Monthly payment if not fully amortizing (the last row then clears the remainder).

tools.name: note_discount
tools.description: A note's discount is how far its price is below the unpaid balance, and this tool gives it in dollars, as a percent, and in cents per dollar of balance. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

balance.description: Unpaid principal balance in USD, greater than 0.

tools.name: loan_to_value
tools.description: The loan-to-value ratio is the loan balance divided by the property's value, shown as a percent, and this tool computes LTV, combined LTV (CLTV) with other liens, and the equity cushion behind a note. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

other_liens.description: Balances of other liens on the property, USD. Default 0.

tools.name: debt_to_income
tools.description: The debt-to-income ratio is total monthly debt payments divided by gross monthly income, shown as a percent, and this tool computes it for a borrower (plus the housing-only ratio, if given). Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

monthly_debts.description: All monthly debt payments incl. housing, USD.

tools.name: seasoning
tools.description: A note's seasoning is how long the borrower has been paying, counted from the first payment due date, and this tool gives the months seasoned and the payments due so far. If given payments made, it shows how many were missed or paid ahead, which helps tell a performing note from a non-performing one. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

tools.name: market_rates
tools.description: The current 30-year fixed mortgage rate here is the latest weekly Freddie Mac PMMS average, returned with the latest daily 10-year Treasury yield, each as a single value with its own data date, source and citation. History is not included; use the source links. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

tools.name: rate_vs_market
tools.description: A note whose rate is below current mortgage rates usually sells at a deeper discount, and this tool gives the gap in percentage points between a note's rate and the latest weekly 30-year fixed mortgage average (Freddie Mac PMMS), with that week's date. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

tools.name: effective_annual_rate
tools.description: The effective annual rate is what a nominal annual rate compounded monthly actually earns over a year, and this tool converts one into the other. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

tools.name: owner_financed_note
tools.description: An owner-financed (seller-financed) note is the loan a seller carries for the buyer after the down payment, and this tool computes the note amount, monthly payment, loan-to-value at sale, any balloon, and the total of payments and interest. Use it to size a seller-carry note before you sell the property or, later, sell the owner financed note. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

down_payment.description: Down payment, USD (or give down_payment_pct). Default 0.

down_payment_pct.description: Down payment as % of the sale price (instead of down_payment).

amortization_months.description: Months the payment is calculated over, e.g. 360.

balloon_month.description: Month the remaining balance is due, if the note has a balloon (optional).

tools.name: land_contract_payoff
tools.description: A land contract (contract for deed) payoff is the principal still owed plus interest accrued since the last payment, plus any other charges, and this tool computes that figure for a payoff date using a daily (per-diem) interest rate. Give the principal balance, or the original balance, payment and payments made. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

principal_balance.description: Principal owed as of the paid-through date, USD.

original_balance.description: Original balance, USD (with payment and payments_made, instead of principal_balance).

payment.description: Monthly payment in USD (principal and interest).

payments_made.description: On-time payments made since the original balance.

paid_through_date.description: Date interest is paid through (usually the last payment date), YYYY-MM-DD.

day_count.description: Days per year for daily interest: 365 (default) or 360.

other_charges.description: Late fees or other amounts owed, USD. Default 0.

tools.name: investment_to_value
tools.description: Investment-to-value (ITV) is the price paid for a note, plus any senior liens, divided by the property's value, and this tool computes ITV beside the note's loan-to-value (LTV) and the value cushion behind the investment. It shows the collateral side of a mortgage note value calculation. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

price.description: Price paid (or being considered) for the note, USD.

balance.description: Note's unpaid balance, USD (optional, adds LTV).

senior_liens.description: Balances of liens ahead of this note, USD. Default 0.

tools.name: early_payoff_yield
tools.description: When a note bought at a discount is paid off early, the discount is earned sooner and the yield rises, and this tool computes the yield if the borrower pays off after a chosen number of payments versus holding the note to maturity. Inputs are the price, balance, rate and payment terms you supply. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

price.description: Price paid for the note, USD.

balance.description: Unpaid principal balance in USD, greater than 0.

payment.description: Monthly payment in USD. If omitted, computed from balance, rate and months.

months.description: Number of monthly payments LEFT (not the original term).

payoff_after_payments.description: Number of payments made before the full payoff.

balloon.description: Balloon (lump sum) due with the last payment, USD. Default 0.

tools.name: prepayment_adjusted_value
tools.description: Prepayments return principal early, which changes a note's value and shortens its life, and this tool prices a fully amortizing mortgage note at your target yield under a constant prepayment rate (CPR) you choose, beside its value with no prepayment and the weighted average life of each. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

balance.description: Unpaid principal balance in USD, greater than 0.

months.description: Number of monthly payments LEFT (not the original term).

yield.description: Target yield the buyer needs, annual % (monthly compounding).

cpr.description: Constant prepayment rate you assume, annual % of the balance, e.g. 6. Use 0 for none.

tools.name: payment_stream_value
tools.description: A payment stream's lump-sum value is the present value of each future payment at a discount rate you choose, and this tool computes it for level or yearly-increasing monthly, quarterly, semiannual or annual payments, such as structured settlement, annuity or seller-carried note payments, with an optional final lump sum. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

payment.description: Amount of each payment, USD (the first year's amount if it increases).

discount_rate.description: Discount rate you choose, annual % (monthly compounding).

first_payment_month.description: Months from today until the first payment. Default: one payment period.

lump_sum_month.description: Months from today until the lump sum (required with lump_sum).
